ValidationRule.description: Requires a ALM EAA greater than 0 when ALM_BU__c is checked. Evaluated whenever any BU box or EAA is edited, or the stage advances (not to Lost), so every BU/EAA pair is re-checked. Insert and conversion pass. Bypass_Opportunity_Validation skips.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), NOT(ISNEW()), ALM_BU__c = TRUE, OR(ISBLANK(ALM_EAA__c), ALM_EAA__c <= 0), OR( ISCHANGED(ALM_BU__c), ISCHANGED(ALM_EAA__c), ISCHANGED(RIM_BU__c), ISCHANGED(RIM_EAA__c), ISCHANGED(Digital_BU__c), ISCHANGED(Digital_EAA__c), ISCHANGED(W_L_BU__c), ISCHANGED(W_L_EAA__c), ISCHANGED(MAS_BU__c), ISCHANGED(MAS_EAA__c), AND(ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Lost"))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a ALM EAA greater than 0 when ALM BU is checked.
